Lobby.title: Waiting for players ⏳
Lobby.description: You are in the lobby. Once everyone is on the list on the left, someone must click the green "Start Game" button to launch the game.
tips: Copy the room code by clicking the clipboard icon 📋 next to the room name.

Writing.title: Writing clues phase ✍️
Writing.description: Your board has been populated with words. Find common denominators for adjacent pairs of keywords and enter your clues on the edges.
tips: A clue must be a single word.
You cannot use words with the same root as the main keywords.
Other players cannot see your cards right now!

Solving.title: Deduction and guessing phase 🧐
Solving.description: Before you is the board of one of the players! Work together to manipulate the keyword cards to match the clues on the edges.
tips: The clover owner must maintain absolute silence and a poker face!
Aim to guess with the fewest number of attempts.
Cards can be rotated using the button in the center of the card. They can also be dragged onto the board using the mouse.
Dragging a card onto an occupied board slot returns the previous card from that slot back to the hand.
To verify correctness, press the "Check" button. If you give up as a team, you can press "Return to writing".
Correct slots on the board are colored green.
